messages:
maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're opening a temporary 'staging' bucket for late performance review submissions and manager approvals. Edge cases only (illness, LOA, timezone). Follow steps below and RT if you own approvals.

sam (HRBP): Clarify: what qualifies as 'late' for this bucket? missed deadline by <48h? managers who forgot to sign?

maria (People Ops): Main deadline was Mon 11:59pm PT. Staging accepts submissions through EOD Fri. Managers must mark approval in the master sheet within 48h of submission.

ajay (Eng Manager): I have 2 late self-forms. Do I need to re-upload or just mark approval?

maria (People Ops): Just mark the Approvals column and add a short note in "staging notes". If attachments were wrong, ping @lisa to re-ingest. Intake: https://forms.redwood.com/review-intake

lisa (People Ops): I'll run the import batch at 12:30pm after approvals. Pre-check rows here: https://sheets.redwood.com/ops-reviews (filter: staging).

noah (Recruiting Ops): Heads-up: recruiting needs headcount lock Mon 9am. If approvals change offers, flag me in the sheet.

forms-bot: Form received: ajay@redwood — 2 submissions. (auto)

maria (People Ops): Import steps for transparency:
curl -o reviews.csv "https://console.redwood/reviews/export?cycle=Q1-2026&bucket=staging"
./hris-import --file reviews.csv --mode append

lisa (People Ops): I'll validate duplicates before import and post a summary. Expect 1-2h processing window.

ajay (Eng Manager): Will mark approvals and add brief reasons (health, timezone).

sam (HRBP): If managers miss the 48h window, escalate to manager's manager and cc HRBP?

maria (People Ops): Correct. We escalate after 48h. Final: book a 1:1 walkthrough if needed: https://calendly.redwood.com/people-ops/15. I'll post import complete here with counts. :white_check_mark:
